title: Norwegian Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Norway, made with fresh fish and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Add the potatoes, carrots, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour in the fish stock and white wine (if using). Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, until the fish is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
